scope: Modified generator and port MMC patch only; did not change build tree, phase, frequency, bus width, or artifacts; no compilation or hardware operations.
reason: BSP v5p3x limits max_seg_size to 1<<12 but writes literal 4096 (sunxi-mmc.c:792); buffer size field is documented as bits 0..12. Mainline zero-max encoding can overrun a 4KiB DMA buffer on this controller.
diagnostics: T153 data errors now log command, raw MMC/IDMA IRQ states before ack, blocks, actual clock and first descriptor words.
